content.title: 2021 ACC/AHA/SCAI Coronary Revascularization Guideline
content.summary: The table highlights committee members' relationships with industry and other entities relevant to the guideline. It lists each member's employment, consultancy roles, speaking bureau affiliations, ownership interests, personal research funding, and other financial benefits. All relationships were meticulously reviewed and updated. Members are required to recuse themselves from voting on sections where specific relationships may apply. Special relationships like significant financial ones are noted specifically. There is a notation regarding Lorraine C. Nnach(sic), an AHA/ACC salaried employee advising on the guidelines.
